name: The Judgment is Necessary
overview: On what was supposed to be the most beautiful night, a white wedding dress becomes a shroud for dreams. A shocking accusation that tarnishes the honor of the bride, Layla, on her wedding night, turns the lives of two families upside down, transforming joy into mourning and endless conflict It ends. As the news spreads like wildfire, forged evidence emerges, tightening the noose around the innocent girl. In a race against time, Layla tries to unravel the threads of the conspiracy before her life and her family's future are forever sealed.
